_comment: v0.4.0 視覺探針正式版（main 27242067 實測通過）。紅暈走真實升溫路徑；低錢發光走 genMission 重繪；帳單 toast 走 21:00 tick。

checks.name: heat_formula
checks.expr: JSON.stringify((function(){var h=Sim.heatLevel(); var expect=Math.max(0,(h-20)/80); var actual=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--heat-glow'))||0; return {heat:Math.round(h), expectedGlow:Math.round(expect*1000)/1000, actualGlow:Math.round(actual*1000)/1000, matches:Math.abs(expect-actual)<0.08};})())

checks.name: low_money_on
checks.expr: (function(){var s=Sim.state(); s.money=50; Sim.genMission(); var p=document.getElementById('misPanel'); var cs=getComputedStyle(p); var tip=document.querySelector('#misPanel .low-money-tip'); return JSON.stringify({lowClass:p.classList.contains('low-money'), border:cs.borderColor, animationName:cs.animationName, animationDuration:cs.animationDuration, tip:tip?tip.textContent.trim().slice(0,70):null});})()

checks.name: low_money_off
checks.expr: (function(){var s=Sim.state(); s.money=60000; Sim.genMission(); var p=document.getElementById('misPanel'); var cs=getComputedStyle(p); var tip=document.querySelector('#misPanel .low-money-tip'); return JSON.stringify({lowClass:p.classList.contains('low-money'), animationName:cs.animationName, tipGone:!tip});})()

checks.name: bill_content
checks.expr: JSON.stringify((function(){var ts=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#toasts .toast')).map(function(t){return t.textContent;}); var bill=ts.find(function(t){return t.indexOf('園區開銷')>=0;}); return {toastCount:ts.length, billText:bill?bill.trim().slice(0,100):null, hasAmount: bill?/\$[\d,]+/.test(bill):false, hasParts: bill?/成員/.test(bill)&&/建築/.test(bill):false};})())
